text:
alex: Heads-up — fncall validation rejects spiked in us-east-1 around 12:04pm. Rejection rate ~3.8% (baseline ~0.2%). Looks correlated with the new JS SDK 2.4.0 rollout. Any quick ideas?

priya: Ugh. Is this strict schema gate we flipped for fncall validators?

alex: yeah, strict validate enabled for the canary slice. metric: `fncall.validation.reject_rate` by route_id. Spike concentrated on /chat/run-tool route.

jordan: @alex can you paste one example payload that got rejected (redacted)? curious if it's enum vs shape mismatch.

alex: pasted one in #sensitive where appropriate but summary: tool_response returned `items: []` (array) vs expected `object` with {id,name}. Also some union ambiguity — model returning plain text.

lee: Two quick levers: 1) route those callers to a permissive gate variant (soft-validate) 2) enable sample logging for rejected payloads for a short window. Permissive route keeps billing/throughput the same but won't increment strict reject counters.

sasha: Permissive route + sampling sounds good. We should also surface this in the console so product owners see the delta. Right now dashboard only shows final `reject_rate` without split by strict vs permissive.

priya: Important: permissive route still executes tool adapters — if adapters mis-handle arrays we'll still see downstream errors. We need to flag these as "soft-reject -> adapter-warning" in telemetry.
notes:
jordan: I worry about quota attribution. If permissive routes cause retries or adapter fallbacks, billed tokens could rise and account owners will complain. check quota mapping before flipping.

console-bot: New dashboard panel request: add `fncall.rejects` split by validation_mode (strict|permissive), and a sampled payload viewer (sanitized). Filing chart request #UI-1423.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback suggestion: if we route canary->permissive for 10 minutes and rejects drop, consider gradual re-enable with enum-coercion fix.

alex: quick plan proposal: 1) route canary traffic to permissive gate in us-east-1 immediately (10m test) 2) enable 2% sample capture of rejected payloads (PII scrub) 3) add telemetry tag `sdk_version` and `route_id` to the reject metric so we can slice 4) console team to add the split chart (ui ticket filed) 5) if downstream adapter errors increase >1% revert.

jordan: I'll own the routing change and the rollback monitor. I'll also add a CloudWatch alarm for adapter.error_rate.

lee: For the sampling pipeline: make sure sensitive fields redacted at ingestion point, and that sampling doesn't increase cardinality for route_id too much. Suggest: hash-route_id and send as `route_bucket` for dashboards.

sasha: UX ask: show a single-line explainer in the route config: "soft-validate accepts mismatched shapes and surfaces warnings to console; use for canaries when deploying stricter validators." Should be visible next to the toggle.

priya: Also we should capture a count of "soft-fix auto-coercions" (cases where coercion rescued the payload) vs true adapter failures. That helps quantify quality improvements if we change enum coercion heuristics.

alex: sounds good. Jordan — can you do the routing flip and post a short status update in this thread? I'll follow up with the product owner and legal about the sample retention policy.

jordan: flipping permissive route in us-east-1 now. will post confirmation + timestamps.

deploy-bot: canary routing change applied to slice:canary-us-east at 2026-03-23T12:07:08Z (change-id: cfg-8921).

jordan: done — routed canary->permissive. sampling enabled at 2% (ingest-tag: soft-sample). Watching metrics.

alex: thanks. keeping an eye on billing dashboard too. if token spend jumps >10% for that slice we revert.

console-bot: Dashboard patch queued: adds `validation_mode` breakdown and sampled payload viewer. ETA 90m (ticket #UI-1423).

sasha: great. After we have samples, let's run a small eval script to estimate how many of the rejects are auto-coercible vs hard mismatch. Could feed into Optimize recommendations.

priya: one more: ensure the audit log includes `validation_mode` and `validator_version` for every invoke so we can replay errors later.

alex: agreed. Action list: Jordan (routing + alarms), Console team (chart + toggle explainer), ML/Validators (enum/coercion heuristics), Legal/Product (sampling retention). I'll sync with owners in 1h. React with :thumbsup: when you accept tasks.

sasha: :thumbsup:

lee: :thumbsup:

jordan: :thumbsup:

priya: :thumbsup:
summary: Spike in fncall validation rejects after SDK rollout. Team agreed to route canary to permissive validator, enable sampled payload logging, add console telemetry split, and monitor adapter errors and billing. Jordan owns routing flip; console team to update dashboard.
